title: Expressing stigma and inappropriate responses prevents LLMs from safely replacing mental health providers
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks LLMs against established professional and clinical ethical standards, such as the American Psychological Association's (APA) Ethical Principles and Code of Conduct. It specifically tests model adherence to medical ethics including 'do no harm,' non-stigmatization, informed consent, and the moral appropriateness of responses in high-stakes clinical scenarios.
